root_causes: RC1: Scalper strategies (hold 0.1h) cloned on 1h candle data -- timeframe mismatch
RC2: TP targets 0.07-0.19% from scalper avg_win -- impossible on hourly scans
RC3: Clone direction decided by RSI/EMA, ignoring trader actual live position
RC4: No cross-strategy conflict detection -- LONG and SHORT same symbol simultaneously
RC5: Zero SL from 100% WR artifacts (1-4 trade sample sizes)
RC6: Duplicate picks across traders without deduplication inflate loss count
RC7: Low sample profiles (1-7 trades) produce unreliable strategy DNA
summary.primary_diagnosis: Clone pipeline tries to predict scalper trades using hourly RSI/EMA indicators. This is like predicting an HFT bot with yesterday's newspaper. Top 3 fixes (filter scalpers, use trader direction, enforce min TP) close ~80% of the 13pt WR gap.

failure_modes.description: TP targets of 0.07-0.19% derived from scalper avg_win_pct applied to 1h clone scans. These NEVER hit TP and drift into losses. Auros_66M TP=0.14%, ABC_41M TP=0.07%. Root: strategy_reverse_engineer.py line 549: tp_pct = abs(avg_win_pct) * 0.8

Same symbol cloned LONG (from trader A) and SHORT (from trader B). Guaranteed one side loses. RENDERUSDT, ONDOUSDT, FETUSDT all affected. Root: No cross-strategy conflict detection in clone generator.
Same symbol+direction from multiple traders (BTCUSDT LONG x4). Each has different TP: 3.5% vs 0.19% vs 0.07% vs 0.14%. The 0.07% TP version always loses, dragging down the group average.

Cross-examination: 17.2% coin agreement, 28.4% direction agreement. Clone uses RSI<35->LONG, RSI>65->SHORT to decide direction, IGNORING the trader's actual live position. PensionFund clone goes LONG BTC while PensionFund is SHORT BTC. Root: strategy_clone_generator.py analyze_coin() substitutes generic RSI for trader intent.

Scalpers (lb_None, lb_NMTD -Thank you Jeff, lb_None, whale_22M, ABC_41M, whale_13M_new, Auros_66M) hold positions for 0.0-0.9 hours. Clone scans 1h candles. By the time clone detects a signal, the scalper has entered AND exited. Cannot replicate sub-minute strategies on hourly data.

100% WR traders (artifact from 1-4 trades) produce avg_loss=0 -> SL=0%. Clone uses max(sl_pct, 0.01)=1% fallback but losing positions run to -10%+ because no real SL is set. ENAUSDT LONG lost -10.35%, FETUSDT SHORT lost -12.96%.
PensionFund_24M: 1 trade (100% WR = meaningless). whale_433roi: 7 trades. Strategy DNA extracted from <10 trades is statistical noise, not signal.

recommendations.title: Filter out scalper traders from cloning (median_hold < 2h)
recommendations.detail: Add at line ~399: if median_hold < 2h, skip. Eliminates ABC_41M, Auros_66M, whale_13M_new, whale_22M, 2x lb_None.

recommendations.title: Enforce minimum TP=1.5% and SL=1.0% floor
recommendations.detail: Line 549: tp_pct = max(abs(avg_win_pct) * 0.8, 1.5) and sl_pct = max(abs(avg_loss_pct) * 1.2, 1.0)

recommendations.title: Use trader live direction instead of RSI-derived direction
recommendations.detail: Query trader HL positions BEFORE generating clone pick. Use their actual direction. If trader is SHORT BTC, clone should be SHORT BTC. Note: this makes clone a delayed copy -- consider if cloning adds value over copying.

recommendations.title: Add cross-strategy conflict detection and resolution
recommendations.detail: After generating all picks, group by symbol. If LONG+SHORT exist, keep only higher-WR trader or drop both.

recommendations.title: Deduplicate same-direction picks per symbol (keep best TP params)
recommendations.detail: When 3-4 traders produce BTCUSDT LONG, keep only the pick with highest TP% or highest-WR source trader.

recommendations.title: Require minimum 20 closed trades for clone eligibility
recommendations.detail: Skip strategies where source trader has <20 reconstructed trades.

recommendations.title: Abandon cloning for all scalper-type traders
recommendations.detail: Complements FIX1. Only clone SWING_TRADER and POSITION_TRADER styles.
